description: This Java interface defines the Credentials contract used for different authentication schemes in the OpenMRS API. It specifies methods to retrieve the authentication scheme and client name associated with credentials.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for obtaining authentication scheme and client identification details for credentials used in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getAuthenticationScheme
methods.description: Returns the authentication scheme to be used with these credentials.

methods.name: getClientName
methods.description: Returns a string identifying the owner of the credentials, such as a username.
